## MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the Current Market Regime?
RISK-ON: low volatility (Vol: 19.2%) with mixed breadth (4/8 sectors positive), supporting cyclical leadership.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy & Chemicals and Retail & Food are leading; Holding & Investment also showing strength.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology & Telecom, Construction & REIT, Transportation and Banking are the main laggards this week.

## STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
TRALT (1W: +15.52% | 1M: +7.91%) ABOVE TREND; GUBRF (1W: +13.48% | 1M: +11.94%) ABOVE TREND; TRMET (1W: +13.19% | 1M: +7.02%) ABOVE TREND; TUPRS (1W: +12.44% | 1M: +29.33%) ABOVE TREND; SOKM (1W: +11.95% | 1M: +7.47%) ABOVE TREND.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
KONTR (1W: -7.36% | 1M: -25.00%) BELOW TREND; TKFEN (1W: -12.75% | 1M: +41.12%) CORRECTION; ENKAI (1W: -5.02% | 1M: -7.45%) BELOW TREND; SISE (1W: -3.62% | 1M: -8.65%) BELOW TREND; SASA (1W: -2.93% | 1M: -12.45%) BELOW TREND.

6. Momentum Stocks?
TRALT (1W: +15.52% | 1M: +7.91%) ABOVE TREND; GUBRF (1W: +13.48% | 1M: +11.94%) ABOVE TREND; TRMET (1W: +13.19% | 1M: +7.02%) ABOVE TREND; TUPRS (1W: +12.44% | 1M: +29.33%) ABOVE TREND; BIMAS (1W: +11.14% | 1M: +6.66%) ABOVE TREND.

## SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Banking Sector Outlook?
Selective: AKBNK (1W: +1.31% | 1M: +3.95%) ABOVE TREND; GARAN (1W: -0.84% | 1M: +3.92%) CORRECTION; ISCTR (1W: -1.12% | 1M: -4.69%) BELOW TREND; YKBNK (1W: -0.90% | 1M: +5.53%) CORRECTION — cautious stance, dispersion within the sector.

8. Industrial Sector Outlook?
Heavy industry mixed but constructive: EREGL (1W: +2.03% | 1M: -13.71%) RECOVERY; KRDMD (1W: +8.44% | 1M: +6.69%) ABOVE TREND; FROTO (1W: +1.39% | 1M: +1.01%) ABOVE TREND; ASELS (1W: +4.06% | 1M: +7.18%) ABOVE TREND; ARCLK (1W: -2.99% | 1M: -6.57%) BELOW TREND.

9. Energy & Chemicals Outlook?
Clear leader: TUPRS (1W: +12.44% | 1M: +29.33%) ABOVE TREND; TRALT (1W: +15.52% | 1M: +7.91%) ABOVE TREND; GUBRF (1W: +13.48% | 1M: +11.94%) ABOVE TREND; TRMET (1W: +13.19% | 1M: +7.02%) ABOVE TREND; PETKM (1W: +7.41% | 1M: -8.78%) RECOVERY while SASA (1W: -2.93% | 1M: -12.45%) and SISE (1W: -3.62% | 1M: -8.65%) lag.

## PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Risk-on stance: overweight Energy & Chemicals and selective Retail & Holding names, trim Technology & Telecom and lagging Construction/Transportation positions; keep banks neutral-to-underweight pending confirmation.

## NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
TUPRS (1W: +12.44% | 1M: +29.33%) ABOVE TREND; TRALT (1W: +15.52% | 1M: +7.91%) ABOVE TREND; KCHOL (1W: +7.34% | 1M: +12.21%) ABOVE TREND; BIMAS (1W: +11.14% | 1M: +6.66%) ABOVE TREND; KONTR (1W: -7.36% | 1M: -25.00%) BELOW TREND for potential mean-reversion.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
Energy & Chemicals, Retail & Food and Holding & Investment for leadership continuation and earnings/commodity sensitivity.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch XU100 short-term support at the recent swing low and upside near-term resistance at the prior rally highs; monitor oil prices, Tupras updates, domestic CPI/rate commentary and FX moves as primary catalysts.

## EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

Low-volatility RISK-ON market with Energy & Chemicals and Retail leading while breadth is only mixed (4/8), so selective cyclical exposure is rewarded. Key opportunities: TUPRS, TRALT, KCHOL and top retailers; main risks: technology weakness, construction pullbacks and macro/currency surprises.
